svg.title: Roadster: a car you can stretch, paint, open and drive
svg.desc: Art direction. A flat illustration, side view, at 800 by 400. A small retro roadster with whitewall tyres and chrome trim drives along a country road. Palette: sky blue #8fd0ec fading to #e3f4f8, sage hills, fresh greens, slate road #4a505e, cream lines, chrome #e3e9ef, charcoal soft top #2f333e. The paint is a theme colour: cherry, ocean, mint, sunny or graphite. Shading is white and black at low opacity, so it works on every paint. The body is three sections: the rear and the front keep their shape and slide; only the plain middle (door, glass band, roof band) stretches. The control deck at the bottom is dark navy #1d2433 with cream controls and a blue accent; lamps are grey (off), green (ready), amber (starting) and red (running).
